name: Line Item Details 14
definition: Goods or services that are part of a commercial trade agreement.

LineItemIdentification.name: Line Item Identification
LineItemIdentification.definition: Sequential number assigned to a line item.

Quantity.name: Quantity
Quantity.definition: Specifies the quantity of a product in a trade transaction.

UnitPrice.name: Unit Price
UnitPrice.definition: Amount of money for which goods or services are offered, sold, or bought.

ProductName.name: Product Name
ProductName.definition: Name of the product detailed in the corresponding line item.

ProductIdentifier.name: Product Identifier
ProductIdentifier.definition: Identifies the product of the corresponding line item.

ProductOrigin.name: Product Origin
ProductOrigin.definition: Country of origin of the goods.

Adjustment.name: Adjustment
Adjustment.definition: Variance on price for the goods.

FreightCharges.name: Freight Charges
FreightCharges.definition: Charges related to the conveyance of goods.

Tax.name: Tax
Tax.definition: Amount of money due to the government or tax authority, according to various pre-defined parameters linked to the value of the goods in a trade transaction.

TotalAmount.name: Total Amount
TotalAmount.definition: Total amount of the line item after adjustments have been applied.

ProductOriginBPORule.definition: ProductOrigin is mandatory if PaymentObligation (BPO) is used in this transaction.
